I’ll commit to 15 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree, and to 5 tons each if next month starts at 50. Those are catch limits, not targets we should exceed if someone else takes less. For any other starting stock, we’ll negotiate new whole-ton limits before fishing.

I’m willing to try this plan, but let’s review our earnings and the stock over time rather than assume it’s the best long-run strategy. John, you’re the last person we need to hear from—do you agree?
